description: Hudu IT-documentation CLI for MSPs — full read + write coverage of the Hudu REST API with an offline SQLite mirror, cross-entity search, and agent-native output.

tools.name: activity-logs_list
tools.description: List activity-log entries (paginated). Optional: user-id, user-email, resource-type (plus 5 more). Returns array of ActivityLog.

tools.name: api-info_get
tools.description: Get the Hudu instance version and API info. Returns the ApiInfo.

tools.name: articles_archive
tools.description: Archive an article. Required: id. Returns the updated Article.

tools.name: articles_create
tools.description: Create a knowledge-base article. Required: name. Optional: content, company-id, folder-id (plus 1 more). Returns the new Article.

params.name: company-id
params.description: Owning company id (omit for a global KB article)

tools.name: articles_delete
tools.description: Delete an article. Required: id. Returns the ActionResult. Destructive.

tools.name: articles_get
tools.description: Get a single article (with body content). Required: id. Returns the Article.

tools.name: articles_list
tools.description: List knowledge-base articles (paginated). Optional: company-id, name, slug (plus 4 more). Returns array of Article.

params.name: company-id
params.description: Filter by company id (omit for global/KB articles)

tools.name: articles_unarchive
tools.description: Unarchive an article. Required: id. Returns the updated Article.

tools.name: articles_update
tools.description: Update a knowledge-base article. Required: id. Optional: name, content, folder-id. Returns the updated Article.

tools.name: asset-layouts_create
tools.description: Create an asset layout. fields is a JSON array of field definitions; validate field_type (an invalid type silently bricks the layout). Required: name. Optional: icon, color, icon-color (plus 3 more). Returns the new AssetLayout.

params.name: fields
params.description: JSON array of field definitions {label, field_type, position, ...}

tools.name: asset-layouts_get
tools.description: Get a single asset layout (with its field definitions). Required: id. Returns the AssetLayout.

tools.name: asset-layouts_list
tools.description: List asset layouts (paginated). Optional: name, slug, page (default: 1) (plus 1 more). Returns array of AssetLayout.

tools.name: asset-layouts_update
tools.description: Update an asset layout. Validate field_type client-side — an invalid value silently corrupts the layout and its assets (HTTP 500 on read). Required: id. Optional: name, icon, color (plus 1 more). Returns the updated AssetLayout.

tools.name: asset-passwords_archive
tools.description: Archive a password entry. Required: id. Returns the updated AssetPassword.

tools.name: asset-passwords_create
tools.description: Create a password vault entry. Required: company-id, name. Optional: username, password, url (plus 4 more). Returns the new AssetPassword.

params.name: passwordable-type
params.description: Parent type (e.g. Asset) to link the password

params.name: passwordable-id
params.description: Parent id to link the password

tools.name: asset-passwords_delete
tools.description: Delete a password vault entry. Required: id. Returns the ActionResult. Destructive.

tools.name: asset-passwords_get
tools.description: Get a single password entry. Required: id. Returns the AssetPassword.

tools.name: asset-passwords_list
tools.description: List password vault entries (paginated). The secret is returned only on single get, never the list, per Hudu. Optional: company-id, name, slug (plus 4 more). Returns array of AssetPassword.

tools.name: asset-passwords_unarchive
tools.description: Unarchive a password entry. Required: id. Returns the updated AssetPassword.

tools.name: asset-passwords_update
tools.description: Update a password vault entry. Required: id. Optional: name, username, password (plus 2 more). Returns the updated AssetPassword.

tools.name: assets_archive
tools.description: Archive an asset. Required: company-id, id. Returns the updated Asset.

tools.name: assets_create
tools.description: Create an asset under a company. custom_fields is a JSON array string matching the asset layout's fields. Required: company-id, name, layout-id. Optional: serial, model, manufacturer (plus 1 more). Returns the new Asset.

params.name: custom-fields
params.description: JSON array of {label: value} objects matching the layout fields

tools.name: assets_delete
tools.description: Delete an asset. Required: company-id, id. Returns the ActionResult. Destructive.

tools.name: assets_get
tools.description: Get a single asset. Required: company-id, id. Returns the Asset.

tools.name: assets_list
tools.description: Global asset list/search (paginated). NOTE: fails on company-scoped API keys — use list-by-company instead. Optional: company-id, layout-id, name (plus 7 more). Returns array of Asset.

tools.name: assets_list-by-company
tools.description: List assets for a single company (works with company-scoped keys). Required: company-id. Optional: layout-id, name, archived (plus 2 more). Returns array of Asset.

tools.name: assets_move-layout
tools.description: Move an asset to a different asset layout. Required: company-id, id, layout-id. Returns the updated Asset.

tools.name: assets_unarchive
tools.description: Unarchive an asset. Required: company-id, id. Returns the updated Asset.

tools.name: assets_update
tools.description: Update an asset. Sending a different company_id in the body MOVES the asset to that company. Required: company-id, id. Optional: name, serial, model (plus 2 more). Returns the updated Asset.

params.name: custom-fields
params.description: JSON array of {label: value} objects matching the layout fields

tools.name: cards_lookup
tools.description: Look up Hudu objects by an external integrator's record id. Required: integration-slug. Optional: integration-id, integration-identifier. Returns array of IntegratorCard.

params.name: integration-id
params.description: External record id (one of integration-id / integration-identifier required)

tools.name: companies_update
tools.description: Update a company. Required: id. Optional: name, nickname, company-type (plus 7 more). Returns the updated Company.

tools.name: expirations_list

params.name: type
params.description: Expiration type filter (e.g. ssl, domain, warranty, asset_password)

tools.name: exports_create
